name: The name is the building
idea: The brand name or one word is set so large it becomes architecture; everything else lives in its shadow.
composition: Wordmark fills 90–100% of the viewport width in the hero and returns once at the end; content sits in a narrow column beside or below it.
imagery: Few pictures, each full-bleed and cropped hard; or one hero object.
pitfalls: A giant word that wraps or overflows on phones; measure it at 390px.

name: Printed matter
idea: The page is an object from the trade: a receipt, a ticket, a form, a label, a manifest. The product's real paperwork carries the story.
composition: Paper surfaces with real document structure (fields, totals, stamps, perforations); one interactive document in the hero.
imagery: The document itself is the image; add one or two real photos of the trade.
pitfalls: Costume without substance: every field must hold real content.

name: The place carries it
idea: A real place (street, coast, room, region) is the main character; the product is shown inside it.
composition: Large location photography with a map or address as a design element; sections follow a walk through the place.
imagery: Own photos of the place first; open-collection archive photos for history.
pitfalls: Generic stock 'beach' or 'city' images break it at once.

name: The product performs
idea: The product does its job on the page: the UI runs, the object turns, the tool processes real input.
composition: One working demo in the hero or the first section; explanations sit beside the live thing, never above it.
imagery: Real screenshots and recordings of the product; no illustrations of dashboards.
pitfalls: A fake demo with lorem data reads as a mockup; use real or recorded data.

name: One object, many angles
idea: A single hero object is studied like a specimen: front, side, detail, in use, against its rival.
composition: The same object recurs in every section at a different scale or angle; annotations and measurements around it.
imagery: Studio photography or renders of one object; consistent light.
pitfalls: Different lighting between shots breaks the specimen look.

name: A magazine issue
idea: The site reads like one issue of a magazine: cover, contents, features, a long read, a back page.
composition: Cover-style hero, a contents list as navigation, alternating feature spreads with captions and pull quotes.
imagery: Photo spreads with captions and credits; archive images welcome.
pitfalls: Too many fonts and sizes; keep to one serif, one sans and five sizes.

name: The data is the art
idea: Real numbers or a live network become the visual: a graph, a map, a counter wall, a timeline.
composition: One big live visualization owns the hero or a full section; text is short and points into it.
imagery: Generated from data (canvas/SVG); one or two photos to ground it.
pitfalls: Sample data that looks real: label previews clearly.

name: Colour chapters
idea: Each section is its own colour field; the page is a sequence of chapters you can tell apart with your eyes closed.
composition: Full-bleed colour blocks per section, one content block per chapter, big numbers or words as markers.
imagery: Cut-out objects or duotone photos that sit on the colour.
pitfalls: Contrast drops on light chapters; check every chapter for WCAG.

name: The dark room
idea: A black stage with one light: the product or the type is lit, everything else falls into shadow.
composition: Near-black background, one lit element per screen, generous empty space used as darkness, not as filler.
imagery: Low-key photography or 3D with rim light; video loops of light moving.
pitfalls: Grey body text on black under 4.5:1; and empty screens that are just empty.

name: Field notes
idea: The page is the maker's notebook: sketches, measurements, handwritten notes, photos taped in, process before polish.
composition: Loose grid with rotated photos, drawn lines and annotations; one clean section for the offer.
imagery: Process photos, sketches drawn in SVG, scans from open collections.
pitfalls: Cute for its own sake: every note must say something true.

name: The manifesto
idea: One argument, stated in a few large sentences that light up as you read; proof follows each claim.
composition: Statement screens alternate with proof screens (number, quote, screenshot). Very little chrome.
imagery: Sparse: one picture per proof, never decoration.
pitfalls: Claims without proof; long statements over 30 words.

name: The specimen catalogue
idea: The offer is a collection; the site is its catalogue with numbered plates, sizes, materials and prices.
composition: Strict grid of plates with data under each; a detail view that opens like a drawer.
imagery: Consistent product photography on one background; detail crops.
pitfalls: Identical cards with icons on top; vary plate sizes by importance.

name: Play first
idea: The visitor plays something in the first screen; the marketing explains the game they just played.
composition: Interactive toy or game in the hero (canvas), score or result becomes the share moment, details below.
imagery: Generated in code; one key visual for sharing.
pitfalls: A game that needs instructions; it must be understood in 3 seconds.

name: Two sides
idea: The page is split into two worlds (before/after, us/them, day/night); the contrast is the message.
composition: Vertical split in the hero that returns in every section; a shared element crosses the line.
imagery: Two matched photos per comparison, same framing.
pitfalls: Unequal photos make the comparison feel rigged.
